Hi, I'm Bethany Jayne - nice to meet you

About Me

I am an illustrator based in Devon, UK.
I focus primarily within Children’s Markets, and I’m inspired by nature, cute birds and animals.

From my childhood, I’ve been a bookworm and loved literature. I've had books for as long as I can remember. Creating my own books has always been something I have wanted to do, so I can educate kids through stories and help them feel a sense of belonging.

Because of this, I grew up drawing and imitating illustrations from my favourite books, which led me to study art at school and then illustration at the University of Plymouth.

Ever since I was a teen, I've always looked at the intricate things in life, when out and about observing aspects of life. An illustrator is not just a profession; it is a way of seeing the world, and looking at deeper meaning of aspects. It means noticing detials other might overlook and believing that even the simpilest idea can be transformed into something meaningful. This is one of my core strengths which i value highly about myself.
